function readToken(j){
 var h=j.headers||{};
 var a=h.authorization||h.Authorization||"";
 if(a.indexOf("Bearer ")===0)return a.slice(7).trim();
 var b=j.body||{};
 return (b.token||"").toString().trim();
}
function authorize(j){
 var t=readToken(j);
 if(!t)return {ok:false,code:"UNAUTHENTICATED",message:"Sign in to access this workspace."};
 var s=sessions()[t];
 if(!s)return {ok:false,code:"INVALID_SESSION",message:"Your session is no longer valid. Please sign in again."};
 if(Date.now()>s.exp){delete sessions()[t];return {ok:false,code:"SESSION_EXPIRED",message:"Your session has expired. Please sign in again."};}
 return {ok:true,user:{id:s.id,name:s.name,email:s.email,role:s.role,initials:s.initials}};
}

parameters.description: Run a single read-only SELECT against Oracle Fusion via BI Publisher and return JSON rows. Only the Oracle Fusion SQL Agent should call this, and only for live data questions. Rejects anything that is not a SELECT and caps results at 500 rows.

parameters.content:
## Authentication — single account
Only raju@oradayforce.com can sign in. Password is salted with the email and SHA-256 hashed by the Crypto node, then compared against the USERS array in Verify Credentials. Sessions live in workflow static data for 12 hours.

## Workspace Data
OraDayForce portfolio — 6 projects (5 client engagements plus the internal Bid & Proposal Desk), 8 agents, 21 documents.

## Agent Chat
Build Agent Context selects the persona and either retrieves grounding passages OR, for the SQL agent, switches to tool mode with no retrieval.

The Oracle Fusion SQL Runner tool calls the existing BIP engine workflow (read-only SELECT, 500 row cap). Only the SQL agent is told the tool exists; every other persona is instructed it has no tools.

Model selection: the UI sends `model` with every chat request (picker next to the attach button). Build Agent Context validates it against the MODELS allowlist and emits modelId; the Claude node reads that by expression, so one node serves every model.

## Retrieval + Ingestion
Search runs a pgvector-style cosine query over the AI-engineering and proposal corpus. Ingestion validates type, size and payload, then returns the pipeline plan.
